newsitem.title: USA: Brazil 96/97 FCOJ 1.055 mln MT -- U.S. ag attache.
newsitem.headline: Brazil 96/97 FCOJ 1.055 mln MT -- U.S. ag attache.

text.p: A U.S. agricultural attache pegged Brazil frozen concentrated orange juice output for marketing year 1996/97 at 1.055 million tonnes, down from 1.085 million tonnes seen for the previous season due to the lower amount of fruit delivered for processing.

In a report dated Nov. 14 that was released here, the attache also estimated Brazil 1996/97 orange crop at 401 million 40.8 kilogram boxes, down 0.5 percent from a previous forecast and versus 405 million boxes estimated for the prior marketing year.

The attache noted orange output estimate for the Sao Paulo commercial area had been revised down by 0.5 percent to 353 million boxes because a lower level of fertilizers, insecticides and fungicides were used in the crop because of cash low problems faced by financially-strapped producers.
"Post contacts also state that there have been some losses during the harvesting and hauling process which are, currently, the responsibility of growers," the attache wrote.
In August, USDA officially pegged Brazil 1996/97 total orange juice production at 1.06 million tonnes.
